pages.title: Megalania
pages.text: $(o)Megalania$() ($(o)Varanus priscus$()) was the largest terrestrial lizard known, a giant monitor that lived in Australia during the Pleistocene.$(br2)Modern estimates put it at around 4.5 to 5.5 metres long. It was likely the top predator of its time, alongside the marsupial lion.$(br2)Like its living relatives, it probably had a venomous bite and hunted large prey, including kangaroos and diprotodonts.
